goal: Make every extension-owned authority dialog emit exactly one externally observable user-attention lifecycle from the shared interaction boundary.

acceptance.assertion: The shared authority-dialog boundary owns exactly one matching attention open/close pair for Enrollment and descriptor-waiver decisions across confirmation, cancellation, abort, and exceptional cleanup without changing authority outcomes.

Every Work authority dialog emits exactly one matching attention pair, stale-authority repair uses authority_repair, and Review reason input remains inside the pair across success, cancellation, abort, and UI or input failure with zero unauthorized writes.
